_notes: Hand-verified golden set for D4.png, built for docs/08 Phase 0. Ids/coordinates come from the Phase-1.1-fusion pipeline's own detections (outputs/golden_prep/D4.json) with TYPE corrected against direct visual inspection of the schematic. Connections are inherited from the pipeline output UNCHANGED (not independently re-traced this pass) -- Phase 0 scope here is classification measurement per the approved go-ahead; connectivity ground-truthing is deferred to Phase 2 work. Two real components the pipeline missed entirely (ZD1, D1) are added with estimated coordinates (marked) so eval can count them as false negatives. One pipeline detection (SYM_015) is a duplicate box on the same physical component as SYM_012 (IC1's LED input side) and is treated as a false positive: intentionally omitted here. Updated for Phase 1.2 (2026-08-29): SYM_004 and SYM_012 were 'Unknown' under the original 17-class library (no Load/Optocoupler class existed) and are now labelled with their real types now that those classes exist -- this file's expectations track the current class set, not the original one.

symbols.note: LOAD block. Was correctly 'Unknown' before docs/08 Phase 1.2 added the Load class (no prior class existed for it) -- updated once the class existed to give a real success criterion for the retrained model.
T2 BC547 -- was MOSFET_N pre-fusion, fixed by YOLO fusion
IC1 MCT2E. Was correctly 'Unknown' before docs/08 Phase 1.2 added the Optocoupler class -- updated once the class existed.
C1 10uF 50V, electrolytic (+ marking) -- was Battery pre-fix
ZD1 12V 1W -- MISSING from pipeline output entirely (false negative). Coordinates are a visual estimate, not pixel-verified, since no detection exists to anchor to.
D1 1N4007 -- MISSING from pipeline output entirely (false negative). Coordinates are a visual estimate.
